verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a no-code UI in which marketers build audiences (Customer Studio, 'the self-serve interface for marketers'). Customer Studio builds traits and audiences on warehouse data that includes collected behavioral events, and a company comparison cites a business-user UI for visual audience filtering. Nothing in the pack shows an estimated audience size or preview count before activation, an explicit element of the story. missing for 10: evidence of audience size estimation/preview before activation, detailed documentation of combining traits and behavioral events in the builder, independent hands-on corroboration of the visual builder.
